canvas.meaning: deep application canvas / outer USER background
canvas.projection: theme-specific dark/base material; must remain visually distinct from nested material where the theme character requires depth

chrome.meaning: persistent shell chrome such as Header/Bottom Nav
chrome.projection: theme-specific chrome material; no business/runtime change

chromeInset.meaning: nested ordinary controls inside persistent chrome

card.projection: theme-specific card surface preserving owner geometry

inset.projection: theme-specific nested material; must not collapse into an unreadable visual hole

active.projection: restrained theme-tinted state; no blanket bright slab unless a future direct OWNER decision says otherwise

accent.projection: approved canonical accent anchor of the target theme

accentSoft.projection: theme-specific soft accent derived from that theme character, not copied mechanically from Theme03

accentStrong.projection: theme-specific strong accent constrained by the same hierarchy

text.projection: preserve readable neutral hierarchy unless the target theme canon explicitly owns another value

textMuted.projection: preserve contrast hierarchy; do not turn into decorative accent by default

glow.meaning: optional theme glow hue used only by owners that already permit glow
glow.projection: theme-specific hue; does not authorize new glow

focus.projection: must preserve accessibility visibility; accessibility semantics remain protected

projectionLaws: Theme03 is an immutable qualified reference unless a new direct OWNER decision explicitly reopens it.
For every target theme, current good rendered appearance is preserved first. The 18-role schema classifies/audits elements; it does not authorize visual copying from Theme03.
A target theme may be mutated only for a confirmed wrong/foreign colour identified by its audit and explicitly approved by OWNER.
Obsolete/garbage colour rules may be removed only after OWNER approves the corrected appearance; no cleanup refactor may precede visual approval.
Same-family authored colour variation and intentional neutral controls are preserved unless OWNER rejects them.
Geometry, layout, typography, business logic and runtime semantics remain outside colour-polish scope.
Admin is excluded and remains frozen; Energy EI/PB, financial/status/error/success, protected brand/provider colours and accessibility semantics remain independent exceptions.
Production and standalone acceptance is rendered/computed and compared with that theme preservation baseline. Source rule presence is not visual PASS.

foundationBoundary.cycle0384: Schema/lock/governance only. No target-theme runtime palette projection.
foundationBoundary.cycle0385: Generator/adapter architecture, fail-closed projection guard and reusable 51-row Chromium harness are established. No target-theme runtime projection occurs in Cycle0385.
